image_description: A white built-in bookcase unit installed next to a fireplace. The unit features open shelving on the upper half (divided into two vertical columns) and closed cabinet storage with paneled doors on the lower half. The shelves appear empty. To the left is a black fireplace insert with white trim. A ceiling light fixture is visible above.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The unit is clearly rectangular and extends vertically from near the floor to near the ceiling, satisfying the height requirement.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tall rectangular frame with horizontal divisions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The structure has a clear outer frame and distinct horizontal shelves dividing the space.

The unit has decorative molding at the top and paneled details on the lower cabinets, indicating finished surfaces and design elements.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase/shelving unit and distinguish it from other cabinetry.
To verify the structural integrity of the shelves and the depth consistency of the recessed areas, ensuring no AI-generated warping.
To check for clean boundaries between the bookcase, the wall, and the fireplace, ensuring no bleeding or fusion artifacts.

focus_areas: Boundary separation between unit and wall/fireplace
Perspective consistency of the cabinet doors
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the emptiness of the shelves impacts the 'bookcase' classification validity given the taxonomy requires 'displaying books'. Check for subtle perspective distortions in the long vertical lines of the unit.
